conditioningLevel.rationale: Re-derived under v0.2 (R2, R3). Value unchanged, evidence base changed: the marker is now formally `unresolved`, which is a material counter-signal capping this field at `moderate` in its own right, and the S2+S3-without-S1 path is `moderate` explicitly under R3. Both paths agree, so the value is robust to the marker question. E2 ceiling: comparative structural intensity potential.
evidenceSignals: MYRISTYL ALCOHOL (rank 3) — long-chain fatty alcohol named in R1's list, at rank 3 of the full list: S2 satisfied on the ordinal read and independent of the marker
DICAPRYLYL CARBONATE (4) + CAPRYLIC/CAPRIC TRIGLYCERIDE (7) — two distinct non-fatty-alcohol lipids, both light-band: S3 satisfied on the ordinal read

CETRIMONIUM CHLORIDE (rank 9) — the formula's only cationic surfactant. Under §3.1.1 clause 1 it is read on its own merits rather than disqualified by an unreliable marker; one distinct species either way, so S1 fails under every reading

PARFUM (rank 8) — marker UNRESOLVED: it outranks every cationic and fatty-alcohol species in the formula, on a low-water solvent-continuous architecture (PROPYLENE GLYCOL @1, ALCOHOL DENAT. @2, AQUA @5)
conditioningLevel.derivation: §9.1 under an unresolved marker. S1 = NOT satisfied under either reading (one cationic species exists in the entire formula). S2 = satisfied. S3 = satisfied. R3: S2 + S3 without S1 is `moderate`. Independently, the material-counter-signal conjunct (a) fires — `tail_marker` is `unresolved` — which caps the field at `moderate` regardless.
thresholdReasoning: Clears `moderate`: two convergent routes to the same value (the S1-mandatory rule, and the material-counter-signal cap).
`high` does not apply: S1 fails, and the marker is unresolved — either condition alone forecloses it under R3.
`low` does not apply: S2 and S3 both hold on the ordinal read.
§3.1.1 clause 5 observed: `unresolved` decided nothing here in either direction; it capped confidence and routed the record to review.
limitations: A three-step concentration scale is at the edge of INCI support; no published dataset maps INCI patterns to validated low/medium/high thresholds (§9.1 honest limitation).
Rank is used qualitatively only. EU Art. 19 hides the 1 % boundary; no percentage, ratio, dose or deposited amount is inferable.
A 7-second stated dwell sits outside every tested contact time; `dwell_efficacy: unknown`, never extrapolated in either direction (evidence §3, `express_dwell_unknown`).

weightPotential.rationale: CHANGED under v0.2 (R2 + R4). `low` is no longer available: R4 makes `low` a POSITIVE leanness test, and §9.2 states that where the segment is not readable — tail marker `absent` or `unresolved` — `low` is unavailable and the field takes `moderate` with the field in `uncertain_fields`. An absence-based `low` on an unreadable segment would hand this product a lean fit prior, and therefore a fine-hair recommendation, on evidence we have just declared unreliable (§1.1, §9.2). E2 ceiling: weight deposition potential, never measured finish.
evidenceSignals: PARFUM (rank 8) — marker UNRESOLVED (§3.1.1): the above-tail segment is not readable, which is the condition §9.2 names as removing `low` from the menu
no R4b heavy lipid at any rank — DICAPRYLYL CARBONATE @4 and CAPRYLIC/CAPRIC TRIGLYCERIDE @7 are light-band, and there is no butter, hydrogenated fat or occlusive hydrocarbon in the formula

MYRISTYL ALCOHOL (3), LAURYL ALCOHOL (14), CETYL ALCOHOL (15) — three long-chain fatty-alcohol species in the list; on the ordinal read the fatty base is not thin, so even a readable segment would not clearly deliver the leanness test
no silicone at any rank ('silikonfrei' confirmed by the list), so the occlusive-stack completer is unavailable
weightPotential.derivation: §9.2 (R4). `high` fails on its required core (no R4b heavy lipid above the marker under any reading). `low` is UNAVAILABLE: §9.2's readability precondition fails on an `unresolved` marker. Residual = `moderate`, with the field in `uncertain_fields`.
thresholdReasoning: Clears `moderate`: the residual, and the value §9.2 mandates on an unreadable segment.

`low` does not apply — and this is the substantive change from v0.1, which recorded `low`. Two independent reasons: (i) the readability precondition fails; (ii) on the ordinal read the thin-base conjunct is doubtful in its own right, since three long-chain fatty alcohols are declared and one of them sits at rank 3.
`high` does not apply: no R4b heavy lipid anywhere in the formula, so the required core is absent under every marker reading.

This is the conservative-failure invariant doing exactly what §1.1 says it is for: the uncertainty is resolved toward the less favourable, less recommending value and toward review, not toward a lean fit prior.
limitations: Weight drives a soft preference with a stated reason, never an exclusion; fine-hair flattening is a fit mismatch, not a hair-type law (§9.2 wording rule).
An ingredient-informed matching prior at E2, never a prediction that the product will visibly flatten hair.

Residual = `moisture`.

`protein` does not apply: zero qualifying R5 species above the tail. Front-of-pack 'flüssiges Keratin' is E0 and, per §9.3's counter-signal rule, protein naming with the protein only in the tail resolves to `moisture` with the claim recorded.
`balanced` does not apply: D6 reserves it for a substantive mixed architecture and forbids it as a 'neither' bucket; the protein leg is absent.

repairSupportLevel.rationale: CHANGED under v0.4 (E11, 2026-09-30): `low` → `high`. The marker is `unresolved` (§3.1.1), which may neither qualify nor disqualify the gluconamide pair and routes the call to a human. Nick read the architecture and ruled reading B for this record: in a low-water, solvent-continuous system the ~1 % band does not sit where PARFUM @8 does, and the pair HYDROXYPROPYLGLUCONAMIDE @11 + HYDROXYPROPYLAMMONIUM GLUCONATE @12 is the product's named bonding technology, declared as a pair exactly as the system is supplied. bond_route is therefore `gluconamide`, the sole route to `high` under §9.4. Confidence is capped at `moderate` (§3.1.1 clause 3; tail_marker_unresolved note retained). R7 standing caveat carried in full: no bond route has strong independent product-level substantiation at drugstore concentrations, and gluconamide bonding's own literature states the hair mechanism is unknown. E2 ceiling: comparative formula potential, never efficacy.

`medium` does not apply as the final value: `high` supersedes it; and no material R5 route exists in any case (HYDROLYZED KERATIN @13 alone fails both legs).
`low` does not apply: it was the conservative reading-A value applied while the marker question was open; E11 is the human resolution §14 `tail_marker_unresolved` routes to.
Mask delta applied: dwell is not repair. The '7 seconds as effective as a 5-minute Kur' claim carries zero classification credit (§7.2, evidence §3).
Confidence `moderate`, not `high`: §9.4 grants `high` confidence only with a resolved, plausible tail marker; this marker stays `unresolved`, so §3.1.1 clause 3 caps it.
limitations: Banned wording observed: no 'repairs', 'rebuilds bonds', 'restores structure' or 'reverses damage' language.
R7 standing caveat carried: gluconamide bonding's own peer-reviewed literature states the hair mechanism is unknown; this value gates comparative formula potential only.

focus.rationale: CHANGED under v0.4 (E11, 2026-09-30): `general` → `repair`. With the gluconamide pair credited under Nick's reading-B resolution, §9.5.2 step 3's `repair` route has its R7 named-bond-chemistry disjunct, and it is the first special-purpose route tested. The cascade was re-run on this record's own INCI and `repair` is what it produces. Confidence capped at `moderate` (§3.1.1 clause 3). E2 ceiling: a comparative architectural direction, not a repair promise. Secondary: Re-checked under v0.4 (E10, E11): still empty. With `repair` primary, §9.5.3 criterion 3 would permit a `moisture` secondary if the cluster independently met criterion 1, but it does not — two humectant-class species against a required three. No other route clears.

HYDROLYZED KERATIN (rank 13) — a single R5 species, not a material R5 route under any reading; the `repair` route clears on the bond disjunct alone
GLYCERIN (6) and PROPYLENE GLYCOL (1) — two humectant-class species; the D5 guard needs three
no silicone, no cationic polymer and no film former at any rank ('silikonfrei' confirmed)
claims: 'Ultimate Repair', 'Express-Repair', '100% stärkeres Haar', '7x weniger Haarbruch' — corroboration only, never creation

focus.derivation: Step 1 baseline exclusion applied. Step 2 mechanism grouping: the bond pair is one M2-adjacent observation; the solvent/ester/fatty-alcohol base is one M1 observation. Step 3 (three routes after E6), first route tested: `repair` requires a distinct R5 protein/peptide film route OR R7 named bond chemistry — the bond disjunct is satisfied (E11). The hierarchy stops at step 3 for the primary slot. Secondary: §9.5.3 criterion 3 permits `moisture` as a secondary when a richer route wins (now the case), but only if it independently meets criterion 1: ≥3 distinct humectants above the tail with ≥2 non-glycerin. Only PROPYLENE GLYCOL @1 and GLYCERIN @6 are present, and PROPYLENE GLYCOL is the formula's principal solvent (lexicon family 7).
thresholdReasoning: Clears `repair`: §9.5.2 step 3's requirement is disjunctive and the named-bond-chemistry disjunct is satisfied by the pair credited under E11.
`curl_support` and `color_care` do not apply: one cationic, no polymer, no curl or colour positioning.
`moisture` does not apply: it is tested after repair and would fail criterion 1 anyway (two humectant-class species against a required three).
`general` does not apply: a differentiator cleared its threshold. It was the value under reading A (v0.2), when the pair was conservatively uncredited.

§9.5.1 discipline held: the repair claims did not create this route; they corroborate a route credited on formula tokens. `bond_specific_support` is `chemistry_candidate`, not `claim_only`, so step 3's `claim_only` exclusion does not bite.
Zero secondaries is correct: no candidate reaches its own threshold, so no slot can be spent without inventing a route.
`moisture` as secondary is refused at cluster size (2 < 3) before its solvent counter-signal is even weighed.
limitations: R7 standing caveat carried into the focus rationale: 'Repair' front-of-pack is frequently an ordinary mask, and this record's qualifying route is architecture evidence, not efficacy.
Wording: comparative formula potential only; no efficacy statement anywhere in this record.
